The '''Battle in the Dellalt system''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attack against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy in the [[Dellalt system/Legends|Dellalt system]]. During this mission, the Rebels discovered that the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] had ordered a new campaign to crush the Alliance: the [[Operation Strike Fear]].

==Prelude==
The mission was a hit and fade strike against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy of five [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] leaving the Dellalt system. Involved in the attack was [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] ([[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]]), flying as wingman to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hamo Blastwell]] ([[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]]).

==The battle==
[[File:Pen.png|left|thumb|220px|A X-wing attacking the corvette ''Bixby''.]]
[[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] attacked the Bixby and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] were scrambled to destroy the transports. The [[Dagger (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|''Dagger'']] was charged to eventually board the corvette.

The strike turned up an unexpected bonus when Blue Squadron reported that the crew of the Corvette wanted to defect. While Blue Squadron's Y-wings covered the defection of the ''Bixby'', Blastwell and Farlander destroyed the entire convoy.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I watched them destroy entire cities just to make a point. I watched them load intelligent beings into freighters with almost no life support and ship them off to who knows where &hellip; I held my tongue, but I'm not like that.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nogdra]]|<ref name="X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
The Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Gorgon (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Gorgon'']] arrived too late to prevent the now captured ship from returning with the Alliance team. ''Bixby's''' commander, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nogdra]], revealed that the Empire was planning a major offensive called [[Operation Strike Fear]], beginning in the Dellalt system. Farlander was selected to conduct a reconnaissance flight in that system.

Shortly after the capture of the ''Bixby'', Blastwell was promoted to captain.
